title: Acyclicity of an embedded circuit list
statement: Let $m,L\in\mathbb{N}$, let $D_1,\ldots,D_r$ be finite directed acyclic circuits with $m$ input vertices, and let $\mathrm{srcs}$ be a list of $m$ vertex indices, each less than $L$. Then the list obtained by embedding these circuits in succession, using the same source list and advancing the offset by each circuit's number of gates plus one, is acyclic relative to the initial bound $L$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of circuits, each with $m$ inputs
Every source index is less than $L
